title: SB 466 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2 and Title 49, relative to elections.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec.1, amends TCA 2-7-112(c) (replaces whole subsection)
(quote) (c) For purposes of verifying the person's identification on the application for ballot, "evidence of identification" is: ... (3) An identification card issued to a current student by a public institution of higher education containing a photograph of the student;
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec.3, amends TCA 2-6-201
(quote) A registered voter is not required to provide a reason in order to cast an absentee ballot by mail; provided, that the voter submits a certification as to the identity of the voter, on a form prescribed by the secretary of state, with the application for a by-mail absentee ballot.
(section) Sec.4, amends TCA 2-6-202(a)(3)(G)
(quote) (G) The certification required under § 2-6-201.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec.2, amends TCA 2-2-115
(quote) Section 2-2-115, is amended by deleting subdivision (b)(7).
(other) Sec.1: rewrites 2-7-112(c) list of accepted IDs; adds a current-student photo ID from a public higher-education institution; the other seven items (driver licence, state/US photo ID, 55-50-336 card, passport, employee ID, military ID, retired-state-employee ID) are listed in the rewrite.
(other) Sec.2: deletes 2-2-115(b)(7); the bill's own description says this is the rule that a mail-in registrant must vote in person the first time (the deleted words are not in the saved text).
(other) Sec.3: absentee voting by mail for any reason, on an identity certification filed with the application; Sec.3(b): non-defective absentee ballots must be counted for the election, including in a recount.
(other) Sec.4: the certification becomes item (G) of the absentee application contents (2-6-202).
(other) Sec.5: deletes the words 'or that category of persons otherwise' in 2-6-401(c).
(other) Sec.6: deletes 2-8-101(b) (content not in saved text).
(other) Sec.7: effective on becoming law for rules/administration, July 1, 2021 for all else.
(other) version: Draft 2278308 (only version saved): carries slots a, c and e as above; no earlier version.
(other) note: Companion HB 597. Last action 2021-02-11: referred to Senate State and Local Government Committee; no committee vote on record. The rewrite of (c) is an introduced text only. The statute's own phrase 'on the application for ballot' is copied as printed.
